name: ClearView Vertex Shader
definition: A vertex shader that reconstructs face geometry and attributes from texture buffers using gl_VertexID, avoiding vertex attribute buffers. It processes 54,000 per-cell faces, each with 4 vertices and 2 triangles (6 indices).
summary: ClearView Vertex Shader reconstructs voxel geometry in the vertex stage using GPU texture lookups, avoiding CPU buffers and geometry shaders.
